The section does not describe any empirical studies or report research data.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents clinical implications and therapeutic recommendations based on a structural model examining relationships among attachment, perfectionism, body appreciation, and eating behaviors. The text emphasizes the importance of helping caregivers and therapists promote body appreciation and secure attachment in women, and provides specific cognitive dissonance intervention strategies to help clients develop a more positive body image and intuitive eating patterns.
